strings.meta.title: pdff — Hlanganisa, guqulela kwaye uhlele i-PDF, Word, Excel simahla
strings.meta.description: Isixhobo sasimahla se-intanethi sokuhlanganisa, ukuguqulela, ukucinezela, ukwahlula nokukhuseleka kwe-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye neefayile zemifanekiso. Akukho kubhalisa, iifayile ziyacinywa kwangoko.
strings.meta.keywords: hlanganisa i-pdf, guqulela i-pdf, pdf ukuya kwi-word, word ukuya kwi-pdf, jpg ukuya kwi-pdf, pdf ukuya kwi-jpg, cinezela i-pdf, yahlula i-pdf, excel ukuya kwi-pdf, izixhobo ze-pdf zasimahla
strings.footer.text: Simahla, akukho kubhalisa. Iifayile zakho ziyacinywa kwakuba inkqubo igqityiwe.
strings.home.title: Zonke amaxwebhu akho, kwisixhobo esinye.
strings.home.subtitle: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, imifanekiso: hlanganisa, guqulela kwaye uhlele ngemizuzwana.
strings.home.trust: Simahla, akukho kubhalisa, akukho uphawu lwasemanzini olongeziweyo.
strings.home.orbitHint: Bamba i-icon, jikelezisa iringi, cofa iphepha elisezimbindini.
strings.home.formatsSubtitle: Ezo zihamba ngokwenene phakathi kwee-ofisi, izikolo kunye namashishini.

strings.home.steps[0].text: Tsala iifayile zakho ngaphakathi okanye uzikhethe kwifowuni yakho.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Khetha
strings.home.steps[1].text: Cwangcisa ulandelelwano, ifomathi yokuphuma okanye amaphepha omawuwagcine.

strings.notice.officeMissingText: Faka i-LibreOffice (simahla) ukuze uzivule, ube ngokuqala ngokutsha i-pdff. Ku-Windows:

strings.workspace.approximate: Kwi-PDF, uyilo lwakhiwa ngokutsha: isiphumo singasidinga ukulungiswa, ngakumbi kuxwebhu oluskeniweyo.
strings.workspace.targetEmpty: Yongeza ifayile ukuze ubone iifomathi ezikhoyo.

strings.language.unavailable: Uguqulelo oluzenzekelayo aluvuliwanga kulo mncedisi okwangoku: i-pdff iboniswe ngesiNgesi.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% simahla
strings.seo.why[0].text: Akukho rhweliso, akukho khadi letyala, akukho phawu lwasemanzini olongeziweyo kumaxwebhu akho.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Akukho kubhalisa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Akukho akhawunti yokuqala: vula iphepha, lahla iifayile zakho, kugqitywe.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Iifayile zakho zihlala zezakho
strings.seo.why[2].text: Kuyasetyenzwa, ze zicinywe kwangoko. Asigcini maxwebhu akho okanye idatha yakho.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Yonke ifomathi
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, imifanekiso, EPUB… kwikhompyutha okanye kwifowuni.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ewe. Zonke izixhobo zisimahla, zingenalophawu lwasemanzini kwaye akukho nto itshixiweyo emva kwentlawulo yorhweliso. Akukho khadi letyala elicelwayo naphakade.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Hayi. Akukho kubhalisa, akukho dilesi ye-imeyile: usebenzisa izixhobo kwangoko.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Hayi. Iifayile zakho zisetyenziselwa kuphela umsebenzi owucelileyo, ze zicinywe. Akukho bani uzifundayo kwaye azabelaniwa naphakade.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ewe. I-pdff isebenza kwisiphequluli sayo nayiphi na ifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), ngaphandle kokufaka naluphi na ufakelo.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, imifanekiso (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML nokunye okuninzi.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ungasebenza ngeefayile ezifikelela kwezi-{files} ngaxeshanye, kwaye uxwebhu oluvelisiweyo lunokuba namaphepha afikelela kwangama-{pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdff ephatha ngayo iifayile zakho: akukho akhawunti, akukho xwebhu lugciniweyo, akukho ntengiso kunye nokuthengiswa kwedatha.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdff yakhelwe ukwenzela ukuba amaxwebhu akho ahlale yeyakho. Nantsi, ngamagama acacileyo, okwenzekayo xa uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Iifayile zakho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Zithunyelwa zifihliwe (HTTPS), zicutshungulwe ngokuzenzekelayo, ze zicinywe kwakuba isiphumo silungile. Iifayile ezinkulu zidlula kwindawo yogcino lwexesha elifutshane phantsi kwegama elingacwangciswanga kwaye zicinywa kwangoko xa inkqubo iphela; ucociso oluzenzekelayo lususa nayiphi na into enokuhlala ngaphakathi kweyure ezingama-24 ubuninzi.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, akukho datha yobuqu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdff ayiceli kubhalisa, idilesi ye-imeyile okanye ikhadi letyala. Amaxwebhu akho awakhe afundwe, ahlalutywe, abelane ngayo okanye asetyenziselwe ukuqeqesha ubulumko bokwenziwa (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ulinganiso lwabaphulaphuli
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala utyelelo ngaphandle kokwaziwa nangaphandle kweekuki (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuba ziziphi izixhobo eziluncedo. Akukho ntengiso, akukho ulandelelo lwamawebhu.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Iikuki (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikuki enye, enokukhethwa: ikhumbula ulwimi olukhethileyo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingatha (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isiza singathwa yi-Vercel kwiiseva zaseParis; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yi-Render eFrankfurt. Aba banikezeli baphatha kuphela iifayile ngexesha lokuguqula.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Qhagamshelana nathi
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Umbuzo okanye uluvo? Qhagamshelana nathi kwiphepha leprojekthi:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Hlanganisa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Dibanisa iifayile ezininzi (PDF, Word, imifanekiso…) zibe yi-PDF enye, ngolandelelwano olukhethileyo.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Hlanganisa iifayile ze-PDF kwi-intanethi simahla (Word, imifanekiso, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Dibanisa i-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye neefayile zemifanekiso zibe yi-PDF enye, ngolandelelwano olufunayo. Simahla, akukho kubhalisa, akukho phawu lwasemanzini, iifayile zicinywa kwangoko.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Faka onke amaxwebhu akho kwifayile enye: i-pdff ithatha ii-PDF kodwa kunye namaxwebhu e-Word, amaphepha e-Excel, iinkcazo-ntetho kunye neefoto, ize izidibanise zibe yi-PDF enye ecocekileyo enophawu lwesalathiso (bookmark) ngefayile nganye.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Yongeza uphawu lwesalathiso olunye ngefayile nganye
strings.tools.convertir.name: Guqulela
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Guqulela nasiphi na isixhobo okanye umfanekiso ube kwenye ifomathi.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Guqulela i-PDF kwi-Word, Word kwi-PDF, JPG kwi-PDF — simahla
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Isiguquleli sasimahla: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB kunye neefomathi ezingaphezu kwama-40. Kwi-intanethi, akukho kubhalisa, Umgangatho ophezulu.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Isiguquleli esinye sayo yonke ifomathi: Word kwi-PDF, PDF kwi-Word, JPG kwi-PDF, PDF kwi-JPG, Excel kwi-PDF, PowerPoint kwi-PDF, PNG kwi-JPG, EPUB kwi-PDF… Lahla iifayile zakho kwaye i-pdff inika kuphela iifomathi ezinokwenzeka.

strings.tools.diviser.name: Yahlula
strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Yahlula i-PDF ibe ziifayile ezininzi: ngoluhlu wamaphepha okanye iphepha ngefhepha.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Yahlula i-PDF kwi-intanethi simahla — amaphepha ahlukeneyo
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Yahlula i-PDF ibe ziifayile ezininzi: ngoluhlu wamaphepha, iphepha ngefhepha okanye onke amaphepha angu-N. Simahla, ngokukhawuleza kwaye akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Thumela kuphela inxalenye yoxwebhu olukhulu olubalulekileyo: i-pdff inqumla i-PDF yakho ngokwendawo ozikhethileyo ize inike iziqendu kwakhona kwi-ZIP archive.

strings.tools.extraire.name: Khupha / susa amaphepha
strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gcina okanye ususe amaphepha athile e-PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Khupha okanye ususe amaphepha kwi-PDF — simahla
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gcina kuphela amaphepha owadingayo kwi-PDF, okanye ususe lawo ongezelelweyo. Kwi-intanethi, simahla, akukho kubhalisa, akukho phawu lwasemanzini.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Iphepha elingenanto, isihlomelo esingenamsebenzi, ikopi ephindwe kabini? Chwetheza amaphepha omawuwagcine okanye uwase (umzekelo 1-3, 7, 10-end) uze ufumane i-PDF ecocekileyo ngemizuzwana.
strings.tools.extraire.options.mode.label: Isenzo
strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.label: Amaphepha
strings.tools.organiser.name: Cwangcisa amaphepha ngokutsha
strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Tshintsha ulandelelwano wamaphepha, phinda kabini, guqula.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Cwangcisa amaphepha e-PDF ngokutsha kwi-intanethi — simahla
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Tshintsha ulandelelwano wamaphepha e-PDF, phinda amanye kabini okanye guqula lonke uxwebhu. Simahla, kwi-intanethi, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Amaphepha askeniwe ngaphandle kolandelelwano? Chwetheza ulandelelwano olutsha (umzekelo 3, 1, 2, 4-end) okanye guqula lonke uxwebhu: i-pdff yenza okunye.

strings.tools.pivoter.name: Jikelezisa
strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Jikelezisa onke amaphepha e-PDF okanye amanye awo kuphela, nge-90°, 180° okanye 270°. Simahla, ngokukhawuleza, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Uskeni oluphendqene phezulu okanye iphepha elibhekisele ecaleni? Jikelezisa lonke uxwebhu okanye amaphepha owakhethayo kuphela, ngaphandle kokuphulukana nomgangatho.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Yongeza iinombolo zamaphepha kwi-PDF: khetha indawo, ifomathi "1 / 10", inombolo yokuqala kunye nobungakanani. Simahla, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Ilungele intesisi, ifayile yesicelo okanye ingxelo: khetha indawo, ifomathi kunye nenombolo yokuqala, kwaye i-pdff ibeka iinombolo zamaphepha akho kakuhle.

strings.tools.filigrane.seoDescription: Faka uphawu lwasemanzini lwesibhalo (CONFIDENTIAL, COPY, DRAFT…) kwi-PDF enobungakanani obuhlengahlengiswayo, ukubonakala, i-angle nombala. Simahla.

strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Cinezela i-PDF kwi-intanethi — nciphisa ubungakanani befayile simahla
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Nciphisa i-PDF ukuze uyithumele nge-imeyile okanye uyilayishe kwiwebhusayithi esemthethweni. Amanqanaba amathathu okucinezela, simahla.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Isango liyayala ifayile yakho kuba inzima kakhulu? Cinezela i-PDF yakho ngelixa ugcina isibhalo sicacile: khetha engenaphoso, enconyiweyo okanye eyomeleleyo kuxhomekeke ubungakanani obudingayo.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Fihla i-PDF ngephasiwedi (AES-256) uvale ukuprinta, ukukopa okanye ukuhlela. Simahla, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Phambi kokuba uthumele iphepha lemivuzo okanye uxwebhu lwezempilo, tshixa ngephasiwedi eyomeleleyo: ngaphandle kwento leyo, akukho mntu unokuyivula.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.tagline: Susa iphepha lokuvalela kwi-PDF ofazi iphasiwedi yayo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Susa iphasiwedi kwi-PDF oyaziyo iphasiwedi yayo, ukuze uyivule, uyiprinte okanye uyihlanganise ngokukhululekileyo. Simahla.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Uyayazi iphasiwedi, kodwa ukuyichwetheza ngamaxesha onke kuyadina? Yisuse kube kanye naphakade. I-pdff ayikho ndaweni ikrazula iphepha lokuvalela ongalaziyo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Shiya ingenanto ukuba i-PDF inamaphepha okuvumela kuphela.
